description: A tall, vine-clad standing monolith of cracked and mossy stone brick rising from a low ruined base, ringed by scattered rubble and wildflowers. A silent landmark that works as a waypoint, a puzzle focus, or an ominous approach marker on a ridgeline or shore.

style_fit.rationale: A strong vertical silhouette (14 tall) that reads as a hero landmark from a distance, in the same weathered-stone language as the temples so the set stays cohesive. Native 1.21.4 source, renders cleanly at 1.21.11. Understated but genuinely hero-scale in height.
